summary: The PR addresses the issue of `:meta public:` not affecting variables by modifying the `get_module_members` method. It also deprecates the `get_module_members` function in `importer.py`.

issues.description: The PR introduces a new method `get_module_members` in `__init__.py` which is similar to the existing method in `importer.py`. This could lead to confusion and inconsistency in the codebase.
The code could benefit from additional comments to explain the purpose of the new method and the deprecation warning.
